summary: Fixed two pre-existing multi-target slot-offer bugs in TargetSlots.cs's BuildSlotOffer (engine-only change) that were causing the 6 CI test failures blocking this branch's PR #564 (the UI bundle merge): (1) two independent-but-interdependent up-front slots (Sudden Movement's first/other, Temple of the Seven Fortunes' bowed/other) defaulted to the same card when their candidate pools overlapped, failing the ability's own distinctness rule; (2) Suiteiru no Oni's 'hosts' slot used the generic multi-probe mechanism (added for Dislodge the Foe, issue #429) too permissively, offering the about-to-be-destroyed 'target' candidates as selectable hosts. Added a new opt-in TargetSlot.ProbeDefaultOnlyForLaterSlots flag for the second case, scoped to Suiteiru only. The rest of this branch's changes remain the PR #434 UI bundle plus the prior main-reconciliation merge already described in earlier handoffs on this branch.
